title: E. coli K12 DNA Extraction
author: Kenneth Schackart
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yujfwun
materials: Gently pipet until the cells are resuspended.

steps.title: Prepare overnight E. coli culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate 2 mg lyophilized E. coli K12 into 10 mL BHI broth and incubate overnight (typically 37 °C).

steps.title: Transfer cell suspension to tube
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of the overnight cell suspension to a 2 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Pellet cells by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 13,000–16,000 × g for 00:02:00 (2 minutes).

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Carefully discard the supernatant without disturbing the cell pellet.

steps.title: Lyse cells with Nuclei Lysis Solution
steps.instruction: Add 600 µL Nuclei Lysis Solution (NL), incubate at 80 °C on a heating block for 00:05:00 (5 minutes), then cool to room temperature.

steps.title: Add protein precipitation and vortex
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL Protein Precipitation Solution (P) and vortex vigorously at high speed for 00:00:20 (20 seconds).

steps.title: RNase treatment and incubations
steps.instruction: Add 3 µL RNase Solution (R); incubate at 37 °C for 00:15:00 to 01:00:00 (15–60 minutes); incubate on ice for 00:05:00 (5 minutes); then cool to room temperature.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with isopropanol
steps.instruction: Transfer the cleared supernatant to a clean 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube that already contains 600 µL isopropanol (IPA). Leave any residual supernatant in the original tube to avoid contaminating the DNA solution with precipitated protein.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA pellet by inversion
steps.instruction: Gently invert the tube until thread‑like DNA strands become visible as a mass.

steps.title: Second DNA precipitation spin
steps.instruction: Centrifuge again at 13,000–16,000 × g for 00:02:00 (2 minutes).

steps.title: Remove supernatant and ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Carefully pour off the supernatant and drain the tube on clean absorbent paper; add 600 µL 70 % ethanol (Et) and gently invert several times to wash the DNA pellet.

steps.title: Air‑dry DNA pellet
steps.instruction: Drain the tube on clean absorbent paper and allow the pellet to air‑dry for 10–15 minutes.

steps.title: Rehydrate DNA pellet
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL DNA rehydration solution (DR) to the dried pellet.

steps.title: Overnight rehydration incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube overnight at room temperature or at 4 °C.

steps.title: Store and label DNA
steps.instruction: Store the DNA solution at 2 °C to 8 °C and label the centrifuge tube with your group number.
